plugin.name: Player (recommended)
plugin.description:
Plugin doctor, environment report, address check and crash breadcrumbs. A message box appears at start-up while something needs attention (a problem that may crash the game, or an F4SE plugin that is not running); its Don't show button silences the plugins it listed. The full report is in Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\Vitals\Vitals-Report.txt.
Note: reinstalling replaces Vitals.ini, so copy any settings you changed first.

plugin.name: Mod author / developer
plugin.description: Everything in Player, plus the developer options: a list of every Papyrus native function and the DLL that registered it, and the engine layout probes. Logs are larger and start-up is slightly slower. Use this when you write or port F4SE plugins.

plugin.name: No thanks
plugin.description: Vitals keeps everything on your PC, as always. You can change your mind later: reinstall and pick the other option, or set bSharePack=1 in Vitals.ini.

plugin.name: Yes, help improve Vitals
plugin.description:
WHAT IT IS When you choose to help, on each launch Vitals saves a zip of its own reports and your F4SE logs, load order, a few game settings, a short PC summary and recent crash logs. The zip stays on your PC and Vitals never sends it. It helps us see which mods break on which setups, so we can add new rules to Vitals that warn everyone.
HOW TO SEND YOUR VITALS PACK 1. Join the Vitals Discord (https://discord.gg/XghtBZUFNW) and press the "Upload" button to create a ticket. 2. Find your pack at Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\Vitals\Vitals-Share.zip 3. Drag it into your private ticket channel and send it. Done.
All personal information (user name, PC name, save and character names, emails, IP addresses, keys, private folder paths) is scrubbed from the pack, and you can open it to check before you send it. Only the maintainer can see your ticket.
NO Vitals-Share.zip THERE? You have not launched Fallout 4 with Vitals enabled yet, or you picked "No thanks" at install. Reinstall Vitals, choose "Yes, help improve Vitals", then launch the game.
Full details: https://github.com/trvxoo-glitch/defib-vitals-public/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY_AND_SAFETY.md#the-share-pack-opt-in-off-by-default
